description: Local read-only Claude Desktop KCS article drafting adapter for KCS Authoring MVP.
long_description: Starts the repository-local KCS Authoring MVP stdio MCP server through uv. In Claude Desktop this extension exposes one primary read-only tool for reviewer-only KCS article drafting from approved sanitized summaries or local approved ticket refs. For prompts like "draft an article" with an approved sanitized support-ticket attachment, the default workflow is reviewer-only KCS knowledge base article drafting through kcs_draft_article, without asking the operator to choose a generic article type. Internal diagnostic tools remain available only in internal/canonical server mode. It is not approved for raw Zendesk payloads, raw comments, internal notes, attachments, customer replies, Zendesk writes, Help Center publication, provider calls, or file-writing tools.
name: kcs-authoring-mvp-validator-control

tools.description: Primary operator tool for approved sanitized support-ticket prompts such as 'draft an article', 'draft me an article', 'write a KB article', or equivalent non-English requests such as 'напиши статью' or 'me escreva um artigo'. Do not ask what kind of article or what language to use; default to an English reviewer-only KCS knowledge base article. Do not invent reuse/search proof; if proof is absent, the MVP marks reuse search as skipped and continues with reviewer-only drafting. If article_type is provided, use only technical_scr or howto_qa. Returns reviewer_only_html for copy/paste when validation passes. Use with either ticket_ref for a local approved summary, or approved_summary_text plus one structured item from chat. If multiple semantic KCS items are present, pass item_candidates and treat split_required as terminal: show candidates and ask the operator to choose one item or provide separate summaries.
tools.name: kcs_draft_article
